title: Reference-Based Bias Detection in LLMs via Relative Representations of Hidden States
reasoning: The paper focuses on a reference-based method for detecting representational bias shifts in Large Language Models (LLMs). While it evaluates social bias against demographic categories that include religious groups (e.g., Muslims, Christians, Jews, Buddhists, Atheists), it does so within the context of general social bias and fairness rather than exploring theological, ethical, or moral frameworks.
